title: ophrys holosericea subsp. celiensis
intro: Ophrys holosericea subsp. celiensis, commonly known as the Celi's Bee Orchid, is a subspecies of orchid that belongs to the Ophrys genus. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues due to its reported health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys holosericea subsp. celiensis are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe digestive issues, and exhibit antioxidant activity. However, more research is needed to confirm the specific bioactive constituents of this plant, which are likely to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites.
